name: GhostCam v1.1.0
added: IMAGE cover: upload your own picture to hide your face — it tracks you as you move
TEXT cover: hide behind a word of your choice, auto-sized to your face
In-app updater: see what's new and install it without leaving GhostCam
Update reminders as Windows notifications, switchable off in CONFIG
fixed: Custom masks now fill the whole covered area instead of leaving gaps
Transparent PNG masks sit on a pixelated backing so nothing shows through
changed: Privacy wording corrected: your video still never leaves your PC, and the update check is the only network call — it can be turned off
